# ECN-2026-030 - Change notice - Machining hydraulic forging press #2

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-HP02

Related documents: MM-P1-L3-HP02, SB-1029, SOP-P1-L3-01

Reason for change
This engineering change notice updates the specified lubricant for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) and clarifies maintenance and recordkeeping actions required during transition and after implementation. The existing lubrication practice has produced inconsistent replenishment documentation and occasional pump inlet cavitation events traced to a mismatch between lubricant packaging and plant dispensing method. The change standardizes the lubricant to a single approved part number to improve supply chain clarity, reduce cross-contamination risk, and simplify maintenance procedures. The lubricant part number for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is CFW-LUB-497.

Background and technical rationale
EQ-P1-L3-HP02 is a high-duty hydraulic forging press used on line P1-L3 for machining operations. Maintenance records reviewed under MM-P1-L3-HP02 and corrective maintenance reports referenced in SB-1029 showed multiple instances where field personnel used alternate lubricants from general floor stock when the original dispensing container was not immediately available. Laboratory viscosity checks associated with those incidents indicated variance from specification limits documented in SOP-P1-L3-01. Those variances correlated with transient performance issues and increased housekeeping for hydraulic filtration.

Standardizing to CFW-LUB-497 addresses three primary issues:
- Single-source identification: Use of a unique plant lubricant part number reduces misidentification and accidental substitution.
- Packaging compatibility: CFW-LUB-497 is supplied in containers compatible with the existing dispensing hardware used for EQ-P1-L3-HP02, eliminating occasional transfer contamination.
- Maintenance clarity: Maintenance procedures in SOP-P1-L3-01 can reference CFW-LUB-497 directly, removing ambiguous instructions that previously allowed alternative products.

Affected items
- Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-HP02 — lubrication circuit, reservoir top-up procedures, and associated filtration changeover tasks.
- Documentation: MM-P1-L3-HP02 maintenance master record — update lubricant field and replenishment instructions; SOP-P1-L3-01 — update lubrication section to reference CFW-LUB-497 and describe approved handling steps; SB-1029 — include a reference to revised approval rationale where SB-1029 records the laboratory testing that supported initial lubricant selection.
- Spares and consumables: All active stock locations supplying EQ-P1-L3-HP02 must transition to using only CFW-LUB-497 for top-up and reservoir replacement activities. Any legacy lubricant stock identified for this press must be quarantined and dispositioned per existing stock control processes.

Implementation
Phased implementation will be executed in coordinated maintenance windows to avoid production disruption. Implementation steps:
- Inventory review: Conduct a physical inventory of lubricants currently assigned to line P1-L3 storerooms servicing EQ-P1-L3-HP02. Quarantine any units not bearing the part number CFW-LUB-497 and tag per inventory control procedures. Record inventory actions in the MM-P1-L3-HP02 log.
- Procurement and supply: Place supply orders to ensure a common supply of CFW-LUB-497 is available at primary and secondary storerooms serving P1-L3 before field changeover. Receive and verify shipments against part number CFW-LUB-497.
- Training and procedure update: Revise SOP-P1-L3-01 lubrication steps to reference CFW-LUB-497 explicitly and to add handling notes for container compatibility. Conduct a toolbox session for operators and maintenance staff assigned to EQ-P1-L3-HP02. Training attendance and acknowledgement will be recorded and appended to the maintenance file for EQ-P1-L3-HP02.
- Changeover activity: Scheduled maintenance personnel will drain and replace residual lubricant in EQ-P1-L3-HP02 reservoirs following the sequence in SOP-P1-L3-01, now updated to cite CFW-LUB-497. During changeover, filtration elements will be inspected and replaced if contamination is present. All replacement actions and serial identifiers for filters (where applicable) will be logged in MM-P1-L3-HP02.
- Verification: Post-changeover performance verification will follow the acceptance checks outlined in MM-P1-L3-HP02. Any deviations observed will be recorded and referenced against SB-1029 laboratory testing guidance for troubleshooting.
- Disposal: Residual stock of legacy lubricants removed from service for EQ-P1-L3-HP02 will be handled under normal waste and reclamation procedures and documented in the maintenance file.

Records to keep
- MM-P1-L3-HP02: Update entries to show lubricant part number CFW-LUB-497 for EQ-P1-L3-HP02 and log all physical inventory adjustments, changeover actions, filter replacements, and post-changeover verification results.
- SOP-P1-L3-01: Maintain a revision note indicating the change to CFW-LUB-497 and include a record of training session attendance and acknowledgements.
- SB-1029: Retain laboratory reports and test data used during selection and verification, and append notes explaining how SB-1029 test criteria informed acceptance thresholds used in MM-P1-L3-HP02 checks.
- Quarantine records: Maintain tags and disposition forms for any removed or obsolete lubricant stock originally intended for EQ-P1-L3-HP02.

Examples and expected outcomes
- Example entry for MM-P1-L3-HP02: “Lubricant top-up material: CFW-LUB-497 installed; filter inspected and replaced; post-fill checks nominal per SOP-P1-L3-01.” Such entries will standardize future troubleshooting and audit trails.
- Expected performance: Reduction in mis-lubrication incidents and clearer supply chain traceability for lubrication of EQ-P1-L3-HP02. Improved alignment between field practice and the technical acceptance criteria referenced in SB-1029.

Approvals
Signatures and approval routing will follow standard plant change control. Approval records will be filed with MM-P1-L3-HP02 and a copy appended to SOP-P1-L3-01 revision history. Approval routing includes maintenance supervision, engineering lead for line P1-L3, and plant operations authorization.

Related documents for reference
MM-P1-L3-HP02  
SB-1029  
SOP-P1-L3-01
